title: Two-Tailed Rat
move_pattern: Randomly cycles between Scratch, Disease Bite, and Screech. After 2 turns, may use Call for Backup to summon another Two-Tailed Rat (can only have up to 3 copies total, and only one rat can summon per turn).
notes: Summoned rats increment a shared counter (CallForBackupCount). Summoning requires TurnsUntilSummonable to reach 0 (decremented by each action), available combat slots, and no other rat currently summoning. Maximum 3 Two-Tailed Rats can be present in combat simultaneously.
